crypto_headlines.title: Citi cuts its Bitcoin and Ether targets
crypto_headlines.summary: Citi lowered its Bitcoin price target to $99,532 and its Ethereum target to $2,838.

crypto_headlines.title: BTC ETFs swing back to outflows
crypto_headlines.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw about $240M in net outflows on Nov 17, and spot Ethereum ETFs about $29M, a day after a small Bitcoin ETF inflow.

crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin miners have sold nearly half their reserves this year
crypto_headlines.summary: Per Glassnode, listed Bitcoin miners have sold nearly half their BTC reserves since January to fund AI data centers.

crypto_headlines.title: Coinbase rolls out Bitcoin-backed loans in all 50 states
crypto_headlines.summary: Coinbase users across the U.S. can now borrow up to $5M against their BTC.

crypto_headlines.title: Coldcard firmware flaw hit 0.17% of users
crypto_headlines.summary: Coinkite's CEO says the Coldcard firmware flaw affected 0.17% of users, while Galaxy estimates $116M in Bitcoin was stolen.

crypto_headlines.title: Circle and DBS open direct USDC minting in Asia
crypto_headlines.summary: Circle and DBS Bank are giving institutional clients in Asia direct USDC minting and redemption with 24/7 USD settlement.

doginal_news.title: DDMIAMI is 20 days out
doginal_news.summary: Doginal Dogs posted the DDMIAMI 2026 countdown: 20 days to go.

doginal_news.title: Bark on building with as little AI as possible
doginal_news.summary: In a clip, Bark explains why Doginal Dogs built their own marketplace, rebuilt the Doge indexer from scratch, and keeps AI out of the creative process as much as possible.

doginal_news.title: Legends Report issue #4 is out
doginal_news.summary: BooMetaX's BuilderDogs Legends Report covers Nov 9-15 for new players of the Doginal Dogs Legends card game (111 cards, 40-card decks).

doginal_news.title: Half of US stock perp volume trades after hours
doginal_news.summary: New Pyth research on the 25 most traded single names: about half of US stock perp volume now trades while NYSE and Nasdaq are closed.

doginal_news.title: Pyth prices 93.7% of RWA perp volume
doginal_news.summary: Per RefractionRWA data, 93.7% of RWA perp volume ($55.6B) runs on Pyth prices, with Chainlink next at 1.2%.

notes: No new original posts from @DDLTCG in the last 24 hours and no drops or restocks; nothing new on Toot, Atlas or Boogie cards.
